sources.title: LDA-1B: Scaling Latent Dynamics Action Model via Universal Embodied ...
sources.snippet: We introduce LDA-1B, a robot foundation model that scales through universal embodied data ingestion by jointly learning dynamics, policy, and visual forecasting, assigning distinct roles to data of varying quality.

sources.title: LDA-1B Explained: How "Garbage Data" Is Powering the Next Robot AI ...
sources.snippet: LDA-1B redefines robot training by turning failed attempts and low-quality data into valuable learning signals. Discover how this billion-parameter model boosts performance across dexterous, contact-rich, and long-horizon tasks.
